Instructions: Use a FOR loop to create a new internal table with squared values.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example16 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example16 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lt_squared TYPE TABLE OF i.

    APPEND 1 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      APPEND lv_number ** 2 TO lt_squared.
    ENDLOOP.

    WRITE: / 'Squared values:', lt_squared.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example16_test DEFINITION.
  METHOD test_execute.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_internal_table_example16( ).
    lo_example->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use a WHILE loop to read values from an internal table until it is empty.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example17 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example17 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_value TYPE i,
          lv_index TYPE i VALUE 1.

    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 20 TO lt_numbers.

    WHILE lines( lt_numbers ) > 0.
      lv_value = lt_numbers[ 1 ].
      WRITE: / 'Value:', lv_value.
      DELETE lt_numbers INDEX 1.
    ENDWHILE.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example17_test DEFINITION.
  METHOD test_execute.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_internal_table_example17( ).
    lo_example->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use a GROUP BY statement to calculate the sum of numbers in an internal table.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example18 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example18 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_sum TYPE i.

    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 2 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 3 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO lv_sum GROUP BY lv_sum.
      WRITE: / 'Sum:', lv_sum.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example18_test DEFINITION.
  METHOD test_execute.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_internal_table_example18( ).
    lo_example->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use an IF statement to check for positive and negative numbers.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example19 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example19 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i.

    APPEND -5 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 0 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 5 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number < 0.
        WRITE: / lv_number, 'is negative'.
      ELSEIF lv_number > 0.
        WRITE: / lv_number, 'is positive'.
      ELSE.
        WRITE: / lv_number, 'is zero'.
      ENDIF.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example19_test DEFINITION.
  METHOD test_execute.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_internal_table_example19( ).
    lo_example->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.

Instructions: Use a WHEN statement in a nested IF to provide complex conditions.
solution:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example20 DEFINITION.
  PUBLIC SECTION.
    METHODS execute.
ENDCLASS.

CLASS zcl_internal_table_example20 IMPLEMENTATION.
  METHOD execute.
    DATA: lt_numbers TYPE TABLE OF i,
          lv_output TYPE string.

    APPEND 10 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 25 TO lt_numbers.
    APPEND 30 TO lt_numbers.

    LOOP AT lt_numbers INTO DATA(lv_number).
      IF lv_number < 20.
        lv_output = 'Low'.
      ELSE.
        lv_output = 'High'.
      ENDIF.
      CASE lv_number.
        WHEN 10.
          lv_output = 'Exactly ten!'.
        WHEN 20.
          lv_output = 'Exactly twenty!'.
      ENDCASE.
      WRITE: / 'Number:', lv_number, 'Output:', lv_output.
    ENDLOOP.
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
unit_test:
CLASS zcl_internal_table_example20_test DEFINITION.
  METHOD test_execute.
    DATA(lo_example) = NEW zcl_internal_table_example20( ).
    lo_example->execute( ).
  ENDMETHOD.
ENDCLASS.
